title: MOT-VID-011 — Five Days Inside a GLP-1 Gut

cards.text: MOT-VID-011 — FIVE DAYS INSIDE A GLP-1 GUT

cards.title: CONCEPT
cards.text: Problem-aware port of the Jevawell glass-skeleton ad. The reference is SOLUTION-AWARE: it names the product in the hook and spends 70 seconds on a 14-day results timeline. This version keeps the concept one-to-one — same glass-skeleton character, same anatomical world, same one-word caption cadence, same day-ladder device, same runtime band — and inverts the ladder: instead of 14 days of what the gummy DOES, it is five days of what the shot does when nothing is aimed at it. Hook, mechanism and reveal all move: no product until 1:23, and the belief flip is TOP-NOT-BOTTOM (the live adv-1 argument) instead of a missing molecule. 401 words, 2:06, 46 picture events. VO-only, Google Flow + Omni. APPROVAL GATE: the glass-skeleton base frame is approved here before anything else renders.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: This is what happens when a woman who hasn't pooped in five days on her GLP-1 takes two kombucha gummies every morning for two weeks.
Glass colon isolated on white, packed with stool. No body yet.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: This is what is going on inside your gut right now, if you are on a GLP-1 and you have not gone in five days.

cards.title: VISUAL
cards.text: ANATOMY. Stomach + colon isolated on pale ground, dull grey-brown, completely still. No logo, no product, no body.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
curiosity, not promise — 'what is happening to me?'

AWARENESS SWITCH. Their hook names the product. Ours names the PROBLEM and answers a question she is already asking.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: Hour one. You eat. Your stomach is supposed to squeeze that food down into the intestine. On the shot, that squeeze is turned down. On purpose. That is how it kills your appetite.

cards.title: VISUAL
cards.text: INTERIOR. Healthy kneading wave shown once, then the SAME framing goes slack and grey.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
dawning — she has never seen the squeeze before

The A/B on one camera is the whole mechanism. Never fights the shot: 'on purpose'.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: Hour six. That food should be gone. Yours has not moved. It is sitting in a stomach that is barely working.

cards.title: VISUAL
cards.text: ANATOMY + INTERIOR. Clock at six hours; the mass dead still, one feeble twitch.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
unease

Time is the device the reference used for RESULTS. We use it for the FAILURE.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: Hour twelve. Food that sits does not just sit. It ferments. And fermenting food makes gas. That is the pressure under your ribs.

cards.title: VISUAL
cards.text: INTERIOR bubbles off the mass, then BODY torso push-in, stomach ballooning against the ribs, her hand on it.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
recognition — THE bloat beat

Lands on the word 'ferments'. This is where she stops scrolling.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: And gas has one way out. Up. That is the burp you cover your mouth for.

cards.title: VISUAL
cards.text: INTERIOR gas column up the esophagus, then WORLD: café table, hand to her jaw, faint green vapour.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
shame, named out loud

Chlorophyll's objection is planted 62 seconds before chlorophyll is mentioned.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: Day two. Your intestine is waiting on a delivery that never came. Nothing arrives, so nothing leaves.

cards.title: VISUAL
cards.text: ANATOMY. Empty small intestine, faintly pulsing. Pull down to a static colon.

cards.title: EMOTION

the colon is innocent — planted early

Sets up the absolution at 1:07 so it does not arrive from nowhere.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: Day three. What did get through sat long enough for your body to pull the water out of it. That is the brick.

cards.title: VISUAL
cards.text: INTERIOR water drawn out through the wall, mass hardening. Cut on 'brick' to her folded torso.

cards.title: EMOTION

physical recognition

'The brick' is her word, borrowed from the reference and repurposed as the problem.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: Day four. So you take the MiraLAX. The magnesium. The fiber powder. Day five. Nothing. And by now you think there is something wrong with you.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: Your colon was never the problem. It is waiting, same as you are. The slowdown is up here. Six feet upstream. And nothing you have taken has gone anywhere near it.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: That is Motilli. A celery juice gummy built for the top of your gut, not the bottom. Celery juice for apigenin, supports your stomach's own squeeze. Chlorophyll meets the sulfur gas where it is made. And a soluble fiber that dissolves clear, keeping things soft without adding bulk.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: It is a gummy for a reason. A capsule sits in that slowed stomach for hours before it opens. A gummy is already dissolved. Two before bed, with a full glass of water. Forty-seven thousand people. Ninety days, every dollar back. Keep the shot. Get your mornings back.

cards.text: NOTES

cards.title: THE ONE THING
cards.text: She is watching her own body, in order, for five days — and the ad withholds the answer until she has already felt the problem. Camera never leaves her body until 0:35. No product, no brand name until 1:23.

cards.title: APPROVAL GATE — base frame first
cards.text: Build the glass-skeleton woman FIRST. 5 variants, pick the most ORDINARY, not the prettiest. She must read as a museum anatomy model, not a horror prop or a film character. Brooks approves her on this board before one second of anything else renders.

cards.title: PRODUCT TRUTH — GUMMIES, not powder
cards.text: Motilli CELERY JUICE FIBER GUMMIES. Clear jar, white cap, green wrap label, 60 vegan gummies, GREEN APPLE. Gummies are DARK FOREST GREEN and heart-shaped — never orange, peach or pink. No Motilli pouch and no Motilli powder anywhere. Every product frame is i2i off the real jar reference.

cards.title: MECHANISM — must match the landing page
cards.text: TOP-NOT-BOTTOM. The slowdown is in the STOMACH, six feet upstream of the colon every product she owns was built for. Three pillars: celery juice (apigenin) for the stomach's own squeeze, chlorophyll meeting sulfur gas at the source, low-viscosity soluble fiber with no bulk. Dose is TWO before bed with a full glass of water. Retired and banned: acetate, butyrate, conveyor belt, gut-brain axis, restore the signal.

cards.title: DO NOT
cards.text: No fabricated numbers — 47,000 and 4.8 out of 5 are the live page's real figures; the guarantee is 90 days, counts on an opened bottle. No dissolves, no camera shake, no zoom drift, no music bed. No insets — full frame only, the single split is at 1:39. Never make the GLP-1 the villain.

cards.title: 3D LAW — deliberate exception
cards.text: Our standing law bans the 3D-render look on generated b-roll. This concept is the exception and needs Brooks's sign-off: the whole premise is a stylised anatomical world, exactly as the reference runs it. The exception covers the anatomy and world shots only — the Motilli jar is still i2i off the real product, and a rendered-looking jar is still a reject.
